text: May 5, 2026 · Guhu-Samane Guhu-Samane is a member of the Binanderean branch of the Trans-New Guinea language family. It has about 12,800 speakers mainly in the villages of Kipu, Qau, Garaina, Bakadza and Sopa in the Bulolo and Huon districts in the south of Morobe Province, and also in Papuan Waria in the north of Oro Province in the southeast of Papua New Guinea.
